The structure of Cr3Fe3S8 is tetragonal with space group I4/mmm (No. 143) and 14 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers in octahedral S coordination (6 neighbors, 2.37–2.50 Å), while Fe adopts tetrahedral S coordination (4 neighbors, 2.17–2.24 Å). Cr octahedra share edges with one another and with Fe tetrahedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
